name: sc10-expired-exactly-once
cmd:
bash -c 
  test "$(/Users/deghosal/Desktop/code/github/agentic-suite/agentinbox/.venv/bin/python <<EOF
import json, pathlib
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in pathlib.Path("/Users/deghosal/Desktop/code/github/agentic-suite/agentinbox/field-test/v0.1.0/results/s0-core/cases/FT-SC-10-LIVE/live/export.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
expired = [r for r in rows if r.get("kind") == "expired"]
assert len(expired) == 1, expired
